findings.description: The KMS key protecting the audit trail bucket does not set enable_key_rotation, which defaults to false. Key material for audit log encryption is then never rotated, increasing the blast radius of a key compromise and conflicting with common cryptographic key management requirements.

No policy argument is defined, so AWS applies the default KMS key policy granting the account root principal full kms:* access, meaning any IAM principal in the account with suitable IAM permissions can use or administer the key. For a key protecting audit trail data this provides no least-privilege separation between key administrators, log producers, and log readers.
